test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

He always wants to be in the company of those who are intellectually superior than him.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The phrase "superior than" is incorrect. The correct phrase is "superior to."

Therefore, the corrected phrase should be "superior to him."

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He always wants to be in the company of those who are intellectually superior to him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2: "be in the company of"** – This is correctly used and does not contain an error.
 
• **Option 3: "He always wants to"** – This is correctly used and does not contain an error.
 
• **Option 4: "those who are intellectually"** – This is correctly used and does not contain an error.
